problems.evidence: Independent A: Actual rendered document: /workspace/refine-worktrees/refine-party-ledger-polish.run/coverage/baseline-1440-light-statement.pdf, both A4 pages contain only the business/party header; opening balance, transaction table and closing totals are absent. Page 1 was rasterized and inspected, and text extraction confirms header-only pages. Current PartyStatementDialog.tsx, shared Dialog.tsx and src/index.css have no diff from de33350. Dialog content remains constrained/scrollable, and src/index.css:81 fixes the print child inside the dialog's positioned/transformed ancestry. This is a baseline-rendered failure with unchanged current print code, not a newly captured current PDF. T10 and guide §28 require actual complete print output. Independent B: T2/T10/T11 and guide §28. Current source still mounts the statement inside max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto DialogContent; src/index.css:81-86 makes #party-statement-print position:fixed and only releases overflow on that child. Dialog ancestry remains fixed/transformed and max-height/overflow constrained (shared [data-dialog-root] at index.css:94 and Dialog.tsx). This source mechanism is unchanged from stable r1 issue statement-print-clipping. r1-checker.json records an independently verified header-only browser PDF; that prior outcome is carried forward, not reproduced by this auditor. Raw detector [] is unrelated to print completeness.
problems.fix: Preserve the same statement renderer, exact data, role/date/filter scope, CSV and window.print handler. Add Party-statement-scoped print treatment that releases its dialog/ancestor clipping and places the whole document in normal paginated flow; hide controls. Validate actual A4 PDFs against screen references, all rows and opening/period/closing money, including multi-page output and phone entry. Do not redesign global print/dialog behavior.
problems.severityNote: Actual statement output omits every ledger row and financial total, so the print task fails; source is unchanged since the verified baseline PDF. This is not a newly observed round1 regression.

problems.evidence: Independent A: Source-confirmed at PartyDetail.tsx:249-266 and PartyDetailResponsive.tsx:396-413: role=tab buttons only set state on click; all remain ordinary Tab stops, with no ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End handling, IDs, aria-controls, or associated role=tabpanel. src/motion/MotionTabList.tsx explicitly provides presentation only and supplies none of that behavior. /workspace/refine-worktrees/refine-party-ledger-polish.run/shots/round-1-main-mobile-light.png and round-1-main-mobile-dark.png show the horizontally scrolling strip with Notes/Attachments beyond the initial view; screenshots establish placement only, not keyboard success. T7 and guide §20/30 explicitly require the complete tab pattern. Independent B: T7 and guide §§20/30. PartyDetail.tsx:249-266 and PartyDetailResponsive.tsx:396-413 still render role=tablist/role=tab with aria-selected and click handlers only: no roving tabIndex, ArrowLeft/Right/Home/End handler, tab IDs, aria-controls, or linked role=tabpanel. src/motion/MotionTabList.tsx:5 expressly supplies presentation only. All tabs remain default Tab stops. Source verifies the incomplete advertised composite pattern; no dedicated runtime arrow-key result is claimed.
problems.fix: Keep the existing underline strip, labels/counts, selected state and panel content. Add one Party-local roving focus/selection model and stable linked tab/panel IDs in both renderers, reveal the focused offscreen tab, and preserve drafts, callbacks and expected Tab order.

problems.evidence: T7/T12 and guide §§9/30. PartyPaymentDialog.tsx:97, PartyCreditRefundDialog.tsx:90 and PartyFinanceDialog.tsx:95 consume FinancePaymentSplitEditor. Its src/components/finance/FinancePaymentSplitEditor.tsx:87-93 renders each decimal amount Input with value/placeholder only, no label/aria-label/aria-labelledby/id. The row is a div, not a labelled field. Input routes decimal values to NumericInput; NumericInput.tsx:47 spreads those props onto the real input without inventing a name (its inferred label is used only on stepper controls). Repeated amount fields therefore have no stable task/row name; the numeric placeholder is not a useful field label. This shared dependency directly breaks the scoped Party payment/refund/finance forms.
problems.fix: Give split amount inputs a translated, row-specific accessible name through a narrowly scoped reusable opt-in for the Party consumers, or an equivalently safe shared API. Keep method/account/amount values, normalization, validators and submission unchanged. Verify names for one and multiple payment rows; do not redesign the shared finance editor.

problems.evidence: Independent A: Source-confirmed: payment validation at lines 53-57 only sets an error string; affected amount/discount/reason inputs at 80/88/95 have no aria-invalid, error description association, or submit-error focus. The sole role=alert at 106 announces text but does not identify the invalid field. The same pattern appears in PartyFinanceDialog.tsx:49-61/84/105, PartyCreditRefundDialog.tsx:45-49/97, PartyOpeningDialog.tsx:50-55/78/90, and PartyTransactionDialog.tsx:42/107. No current open validation-state image was supplied among the original round shots, so visual geometry and runtime focus are unverified; the missing attributes and handlers are directly verified in source. T7/T9 and guide §7/14 require associated errors and first-invalid focus. Independent B: T7/T9 and guide §§7/14/30. Failed payment review sets one bottom error string and returns (PartyPaymentDialog.tsx:53-57,106) without aria-invalid, aria-describedby/error IDs, or focus movement on amount/discount/reason/splits. Refund repeats this at PartyCreditRefundDialog.tsx:45-49,97; finance at PartyFinanceDialog.tsx:51-61,105; opening at PartyOpeningDialog.tsx:50-55,77-90. Visible labels and role=alert exist, so this is a specific association/recovery gap rather than no error feedback. Source verified; no fresh browser validation reproduction.
problems.fix: Expose existing validation outcomes on the affected fields with stable error IDs, aria-invalid/aria-describedby, and focus the first invalid field or existing error summary after failed review/save. Use Party-local presentation state and a narrow shared opt-in only where required for split fields. Preserve the exact validators, domain messages, payloads and stored draft values.
problems.severityNote: The existing alert announces errors, but advertised accessible form recovery lacks field association and first-invalid focus; no financial validation change is permitted.

problems.evidence: Independent A: Source-confirmed controls in PartyDetailResponsive.tsx:539-540 and PartyDetail.tsx:380-381 are raw buttons with a 14px glyph and p-1, yielding approximately 22px targets with only gap-1 between edit and destructive delete. They bypass the approved shared 36px icon Button and declare no local focus-visible treatment. The supplied round shots show Ledger rather than the Notes tab, so this is a verified implementation/size-contract gap, not a claim of a newly observed Notes screenshot. T4/T7 and guide §8/21 require ordinary icon controls at the shared 36px size with useful separation. Independent B: T4/T7/T12 and guide §§8/21. Notes Edit/Delete remain raw buttons with size-3.5 (14px) icons plus p-1 (4px per side), approximately 22px targets, in gap-1 at PartyDetailResponsive.tsx:538-540 and PartyDetail.tsx:379-381. They do not receive the shared .hisabiq-button 36px geometry. This violates the explicit product icon-action contract and makes adjacent routine actions harder to tap. Four-pixel spacing may satisfy the WCAG 24px target-spacing exception; no blanket 44px WCAG failure is asserted.
problems.fix: Reuse shared Button size=icon with the existing ghost/danger semantic styling and translated accessible labels. Retain exact edit/delete callbacks and dialog behavior; use the required 36px controls without changing the notes layout or global defaults.
problems.severityNote: Verified 36px product-contract gap; the available evidence does not establish a blanket WCAG target-size failure.

problems.evidence: Independent A: /workspace/refine-worktrees/refine-party-ledger-polish.run/shots/round-1-main-desktop-light.png and round-1-main-desktop-dark.png, 1440px toolbar: Reset is grouped beside the page-size 25 selector, separated from All transactions. Source at PartyLedgerToolbar.tsx:38-46 confirms that grouping. PartyLedgerToolbarResponsive.tsx:62-74 likewise groups Reset with Rows, placing it on the following grid row at 320px. The owner-approved taste appendix and RESPONSIVE-FILTER-ACTION-PATTERN.md require Reset directly beside the final status/type filter. Current reset callback remains intact; this finding concerns grouping, not accounting/filter semantics. Independent B: T1/T8 and the explicit 2026-11-05 filter-row rule require Reset immediately beside the final type/status filter. PartyLedgerToolbar.tsx:38-46 renders Transaction type followed by a separate Rows-per-page-plus-Reset group. PartyLedgerToolbarResponsive.tsx:62-75 similarly groups Reset inside the Rows wrapper, after Type. The current source preserves full reset semantics and translated labels but associates the action with pagination instead of the filter. Stable lower-ranked r1 checker issue ledger-reset-filter-grouping remains.
problems.fix: Place the existing 36px Reset icon immediately beside Transaction type in both toolbar presentations, retaining the onReset callback, full reset scope, translated title/ARIA label, visible order and compact responsive filter layout. Keep Rows per page and print available.

problems.evidence: T5 and guide §5. Round 1 removed the directory tabular-nums utility, but src/index.css:39 still sets body font-feature-settings: tnum 1. Neither PartyDirectory nor PartyDirectoryResponsive has a normal/pnum feature reset or the data-erp-table/data-erp-table-view markers whose source rule at index.css:784-794 resets inherited numeric features. Thus removing only the utility does not clear the inherited low-level tnum feature. Additionally PartyDetail.tsx:326 and PartyDetailResponsive.tsx:485 explicitly retain tabular-nums on invoice/payment money outside a marked table surface. No other source override was found in layout/theme CSS. This is CSS inheritance evidence, not a measured glyph/computed-style result; retain the stable lower-ranked r1 checker ID.
problems.fix: Use a narrow Party presentation numeric-feature reset for the affected directory and non-table money surfaces, and remove explicit local tabular-nums there. Preserve Geist/Hind Siliguri, exact formatting, amounts and alignment. Verify computed font-feature-settings/font-variant-numeric in desktop/mobile directory and invoice/payment rows without editing the global body rule.
